description: Source code for TinyMCE plugin 'layer', including plugin registration, event handling, UI control generation, and DOM manipulation functions.

methods.name: getInfo
methods.description: Returns plugin information such as name, author, URL, and version.

methods.name: initInstance
methods.description: Initializes the plugin instance, setting 2D position for IE browsers.

methods.name: handleEvent
methods.description: Handles focus and style events related to the plugin.

methods.name: handleVisualAid
methods.description: Adds or removes visual aid CSS classes to div elements based on position.

methods.name: getControlHTML
methods.description: Generates HTML for control buttons based on command name.

methods.name: execCommand
methods.description: Executes commands like insert layer, move forward/backward, toggle absolute positioning.

methods.name: handleNodeChange
methods.description: Updates button states based on current node focus and style.

methods.name: _move
methods.description: Changes z-index of the parent layer element.

methods.name: _getParentLayer
methods.description: Finds the parent layer element with position style.

methods.name: _insertLayer
methods.description: Creates and inserts a new layer div at the current position.

methods.name: _toggleAbsolute
methods.description: Toggles the absolute positioning style of the parent layer element.
